title: Would an AI companion help with loneliness, or make it easier to give up on people?
discussion_signal: The thread presents AI companionship as both accessible support and a possible avoidance route. Replies describe disability, social anxiety, and human relationship difficulty as reasons for use, while also insisting that AI should not be treated as a complete replacement for human connection.
linked_research_question: When does AI companionship operate as support, substitution, continuity, or dependence, and what happens when the service changes or disappears?
limits: The discussion cannot establish mental-health effects, prevalence, or durable relationship substitution
